help.title: Help
help.step1: Pick a faction, then a leader. In a match, start with your opponent's.
help.step2: Type the cards you see into the Search box (press /), a tag such as Beast or Devotion, or an author. Each one narrows the list. Type - first to exclude one.
help.step3: Most common shows the cards the remaining decks run; Least common shows rare surprises. Click one to add it.
help.step4: All lists decks with everything you've added; Any lists decks with at least one, best matches first.
help.step5: Click a deck to see its cards. ↗ opens it on playgwent.com to import; ▶ plays a gameplay video, when there is one. ⧉ shows only that deck, as if you'd pasted its link.
help.stepCraft: Craft, next to Decks, lists the cards the matching decks run and what each costs to craft: a guide to where to spend your scraps.
help.step6: Spare: room to upgrade a card. Over: costs have changed and the deck no longer fits.
help.step7: Clear all starts over; your browser's Back button undoes it.
help.search1: Tags (#) such as Beast or Devotion, and authors (✎) by their playgwent or YouTube channel name, narrow the list like cards.
help.search2: Type - before a name, or click a pick you've added, to find decks without it. Excluded picks look faded and struck through.
help.search3: Paste a playgwent.com deck or guide link to find that deck, with its guide and video. Back restores your search.
help.search4: Names match in your language or in English, and accents don't matter: coen finds Coën.
help.similar1: ≈ on any deck lists the decks with its leader that fit (Spare or Exact) and share at least {n} of its 25 cards, most in common first.
help.similar2: Turn on the deck's own provision step to list it too, marked This deck. Show changes compares each deck with it, even while it's hidden: shared cards fade, added ones get +, and the ones swapped out are listed.
help.similar3: Use it to find a playable version of an Over deck, or variations of your own. ✕ on the Similar pill, or Back, returns to your search.
help.filters1: Every option shows how many decks it would leave; a dimmed 0 means none.
help.filters2: Source: Community (guides on playgwent.com and decks from creators' videos), or a creator's deck list.
help.filters3: Guide & video: ▶ Has video keeps decks with a gameplay video; a language keeps decks whose guide or video is in it.
help.filters4: Provisions: how far a deck is from today's limit, 150 plus the leader's bonus. Pick several steps to combine them.
help.filters5: Stratagem: players swap these freely, so the same list often appears under another one.
help.craft1: Craft lists the cards the matching decks run, most used first, with what each costs to craft. With no filters, the top is the staples every faction plays. It's a guide to what published decks use, not a guarantee a card is right for you.
help.craft2: Type the scraps you have: a line marks how far down the list they go. Tick Have it on cards you own to leave them out; ticks last until you reload.
help.craft3: Click a card to see the decks that run it; Back returns to the list.
